report:
Reviewed the complete terminal_obligations claim, the one ordinary InferCtx::finalize implementation association and its supplied whole-file context, and the complete associated test set (one TODO function). Independently verified exact byte equality of current infer_ctx.rs and semantic_spec.rs with the historical implementation_sources/test_sources snapshots; the earlier rationale remains appropriate, but equality is baseline evidence rather than behavioral execution.

Source reassessment: ready proofs run before fallback; never-target fallback, final bounds and unresolved-variable diagnostics publish inference changes; ready obligations run again before terminally_discharge_obligations. Proof and normalization responses retain residual goals during ordinary checking, while terminal Maybe and nontrivial residual responses call fail_obligation, which records diagnostics and marks the obligation terminal. Existing error recovery can also terminalize obligations. The mandatory pass asserts no pending obligations; finish separately checks pending obligations, root branches, runtime quiescence and unpublished wakes before constructing CheckedBody. This supports the no-residual-publication requirement and the handling of incomplete responses as terminal diagnostics rather than silent ongoing work. Captured the linked architectural-foundations incompleteness section: ambiguity/resource exhaustion are terminal conservative outcomes, distinct from logical falsity; the reviewed terminal branches use unresolved/conditional diagnostics distinct from unsatisfied obligations.

Test adequacy remains explicitly deferred: sage_meta::todo::inference_terminal_obligations has an empty body and supplies no behavioral assertions. Its comment accounts for immediate solution, inference wakeup, canonical deduplication, terminal rejection, resource exhaustion, and successful completion with no obligations/tasks/wakes/root branches. Completing that verification matrix requires fixtures that drive each solver outcome and expose/assert all quiescence registries, including a reproducible resource-limit outcome; until those tests exist this is not complete verified implementation. No N/A entries or ordinary associated tests exist. This accepted TODO preserves the documented gap, including the resource-limit/incompleteness edge cases, rather than treating unrelated tests in the implementation file as anchor coverage. No edits are requested to the current accounting.

Execution: personally ran review start, exact snapshot comparison, captured review read and review record; no behavior tests or broad builds were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; those results do not establish the deferred matrix.
